01a0daa5-62d4-7772-88a3-911da5b647c3.text: 2026-10-16, measured: the telemetry NDJSON holds 21 events for October (7 each of created, deleted, completed), the last on Oct 14, though dozens of CLI add/update/cancel/jot/close calls ran on Oct 16. It is not yet the record of intent history it is meant to be. Open (Darrion): does that history live in the repo, and is it the same stream as debugging telemetry, given the 1-year deletion default in observability.md?

2026-11-04, Darrion and the facilitator designed views and metrics, then Darrion parked it here as a scope increase before the first usable iteration (assistant memory/log.md, 2026-11-04). Views: plain data, a few tested shapes (gate, chain, checklist, decision) and a per-project lens; a view must let Darrion react, writing back through clearhead transact with --dry-run as preview (gaps: no create operation, no format for a pending proposal); never hosted on claude.ai; split by project; human items written to be finishable (kind of ask, time, steps as children, links). Metrics: ClearHead workspace data, one entry per metric with a query, command or ossie implementation; objectives may reference a metric and a target; composition is arithmetic over metric ids at one as-of time and scope, empty on divide by zero unless the metric declares when_empty; interoperable through a JSON Schema, RDF mapped to QUDT or UCUM, CCO and Data Cube, and Ossie export, with Ossie not the native format (pre-1.0, no composition, no cross-model ids).
